prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: wide 16:9 title-screen key art for the cute 2D Korean action RPG BruteForce 21.
Primary request: Draw one polished cohesive ensemble illustration showing exactly FIVE playable animal heroes posing according to their jobs in a Seoul nighttime city. Use the five supplied character reference portraits only for design identity, colors, faces and clothing, not their existing poses.
Scene/backdrop: luminous deep navy Seoul/Yeoksam city at night, glass towers, small warm street lights, neon cyan and violet reflections on the street, subtle night haze, cinematic heroic but adorable energy.
Subjects, left to right: (1) navy-and-white chubby penguin, orange beak and feet, pale blue SSAFY hoodie, confident melee fighter with one fist forward and one hand holding a sheathed katana at the hip, modest broad shoulders, keep a small cute penguin body, not a human; (2) gray-and-white fluffy cat in pale blue hoodie, red hair bow and red neck bandana, spirited protester poised with a raised claw and a small ballot box nearby; (3) white rabbit with long pink inner ears and LARGE ROUND BLACK GLASSES, blue-purple mage cape and violet gem, one paw casting a small violet magical orb and the other proudly saluting, unmistakable original rabbit identity; (4) round fluffy YELLOW chick in white SSAFY hoodie, orange feet, hacker standing while typing on an open dark laptop with restrained cyan code sparks, do not turn it into a duck; (5) BROWN otter with cream muzzle, long otter tail, mascara lashes but NO pink eye makeup, feminine black-and-gold short idol dress with leopard bow and sunglasses atop head, lively dancing pose holding microphone, a few pink hearts and aqua droplets. Match the otter reference, no human characters.
Style: high quality cute Korean webcomic/anime game promotional illustration, clean expressive dark outlines, painterly cel-shaded details, rounded chibi proportions, fully rendered rich lighting. These five animals are friends, all clearly distinguishable and similarly sized.
Composition/framing: LANDSCAPE 16:9. Keep ALL FIVE characters, ears, props and feet fully visible in a compact central group spanning the middle 65 percent of image width and between 27 and 81 percent of image height. Leave quiet dark city sky at upper left for a real HTML game title. Leave the bottom center 15 percent as uncluttered street for a real HTML start button. Do not put any subject behind those UI safe areas. Keep enough lateral and vertical breathing room; complete scenic background to edges. No extra animals, no giant penguin, no military clothing.
Text: NO embedded title, captions, speech bubbles, signs or button labels. Small SSAFY hoodie lettering is allowed. Title and button will be overlaid in code.
Constraints: exactly five characters, preserve reference identity and glasses, no collage, no panels, no sprite sheet, no watermark. Opaque complete nighttime background.
